Hi, I'm **treeahsee** — an engineer with the memory of a goldfish. If I read
something once and nod along, it's gone by next week. My grug brain only holds
onto an idea if I write it down in my own words, badly at first, until it makes
sense.

This site is that pile of notes: mostly machine learning and the systems
underneath it, re-explained until they stick. If a note here reads like a
polished textbook summary, I probably didn't actually understand it yet.
